description: This file defines the ActivitiesParseRule class, which extends BaseRule, and provides methods for preprocessing and parsing panels related to activity data within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It specifically modifies panel data for DetailView and handles certain field transformations based on regex pattern matching.

classes.name: ActivitiesParseRule
classes.description: A class that extends BaseRule to perform specific parsing and preprocessing of activity panel data in the CRM views.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Preprocesses panel data before rendering, particularly modifying 'duration_minutes' to 'duration_hours' and 'time_start' to 'date_start' in DetailView.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Further processes panel data, clearing 'duration_minutes' fields with regex match during parsing.
